text: The results from your audiometry, MRI of the internal auditory canals, and vestibular hyperactivity test are all normal. To narrow down the cause of this brief episode, have you noticed any new or worsening headache, particularly one that is worse when you bend over or cough?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Dix-Hallpike Maneuver: Positive, inducing nystagmus and reproducing patient's symptoms of vertigo when head is turned to the left and laid back.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The positive Dix-Hallpike maneuver with nystagmus and vertigo upon head movement, combined with normal imaging and audiometry, confirms a diagnosis of BPPV.
